forget_server_body: This device stops remembering the server and any accounts saved for it. Nothing on the server itself changes.
self_signed_before: If this server uses a self-signed certificate, open
self_signed_after: once, accept the certificate warning, then try again.
protocol_mismatch: Server speaks protocol {server}; this client expects {client}. Some things may not work.
trust_body_before: Nightcord servers are run by people, not by Nightcord. The owner of this server and its staff can see your
trust_body_note: Connect only if you know who runs it. You'll see this once per server.
username_requirements: Username must be 3–32 characters: letters, digits, _ . -
setup_ready: Your server is ready. Create a guild to get started!
auth_notice_register: You are creating an account on {server}.
auth_notice_request: You are requesting an account on {server}.
accounts_closed: This server isn't accepting new accounts.
request_sent: Request sent. You can log in once the server owner approves it.
banned_generic: You've been banned from this server.
logged_out: You were logged out. Please log in again.
must_accept_rules: You need to accept a server's rules to join it.
adding_account: Log in with another account. Your other accounts stay saved on this device.
grass_body: You've been here {hours} hours straight. Outside is still there.
grass_note: You can turn this off in Settings → Notifications.
